A hero, also known as an adventurer, is the terminology used for the player character in Minecraft Dungeons.

A player must choose a hero before playing the game. Many options are available. There are four heroes that are deemed as being the strongest. Unlike in Minecraft, no custom heroes can be brought into the game without using third party game mods.

A hero interacts with in-game objects, mobs, and non-player characters (NPCs). The NPCs in the Camp interact with the player's hero. The in-game narrator also refers to the player's character as the "hero".

In contrast to the hero, the player interacts with things outside the game, such as game menus like the hero selector, options, purchasing downloadable content (DLC), and developer interactions.

History

Minecraft Dungeons
September 29, 2018 Hal, Hedwig, Hex and Valorie appear within the Minecraft Dungeons announcement trailer. Hedwig is missing the hat layer.
June 9, 2019 Hal, Hedwig, Hex and Valorie appear in the Minecraft Dungeons gameplay reveal trailer. Hedwig now has their hat layer and Valorie is named.
October 31, 2019 A twitter post revealed that there would be no classes for heroes.
November 22, 2019 Alex, Bediako, Sergey and Valorie appear in the Minecraft Dungeons Diaries episode "Meet the Team".[2]
November 28, 2019 Darian, Hex and Jade, appear in the Minecraft Dungeons extended gameplay demo.
Dungeons Beta Added Alex, Annika, the Archeologist, Baako, Bediako, Darian, Elaine, Eshe, Esperanza, the Explorer, Frosty, Fuego, Greta, Hal, Hedwig, Hex, Igor, Jade, Mayeso, Morris, Neo, Nuru, Pake, Qamar, Sam, Sergey, Shikoba, Steve, Sven, Valorie, Violet, Wargen, the Winter Warrior, and Zola.
1.5.0.0 Added the Emerald, the End Rogue, the Llama, and the Nether Warrior.
1.6.0.0 Added Christina, Dani, Loge, and Tim. Removed the Emerald and the Llama.
1.8.0.0 Re-added the Emerald and the Llama. Added Skelly and the Strider Warrior.
1.9.1.0 Added the Kelptomaniac and the Monumental.
1.10.2.0 Added the Void Voyager and the Corrupted Defender.
October 16, 2021 More heroes are announced to be coming soon to the game, with 10 brand new heroes.[3]
1.12.0.0 Added Barbarian, Blacksmith, Cloudwatcher, Enderling, High-Flyer, Knight, Keeper, Mobbo, Pride, Tower Avatar and Warrior.
1.14.1.0 Added Abominable Imposter, Amethyst Scout, Amethyst Warrior, Fungi Fan, Glow-Getter, Horticulturist, Ink ArtistMetal Miner, Redstone Monstrosity and Web Crawler.
1.16.2.0 Added Bee Bestie, Claw Marks, Cow Onesie, Feathers, Fishy, Jellyfish Girl, Owl Bestie, Paw Prints, Penguin Onesie and Pig Onesie.

Trivia

  • The Llama is the only hero without a lightmap.
  • Christina, Dani, Loge, and Tim are references to the Xbox, PlayStation, Windows, and Nintendo Switch versions of the game, respectively. They were added in 1.6.0.0, the version that brought cross-play between all four versions.
